'''August 1999 Glasgow tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG regional qualifier held in Glasgow, Scotland on 21 August 1999. Hamish won it. It is known from Iain Reid's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d20">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-25-glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99d20/ glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99], DeckTech (Iain "Corpboy" Reid, 25 August 1999). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/1999-08-25-glasgow-uk-8-21-99-and-newcastle-uk-8-22-99d20/ GitHub Pages].</ref> It was played alongside the [[August 1999 Newcastle tournament]].

* '''Date:''' 21 August 1999
* '''Site:''' Glasgow, Scotland
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Winner:''' Hamish
